name: Petras Auštrevičius - § 32
title: REPORT on the EU enlargement strategy
part_text: Repeats its call for the EU’s capacity to act to be enhanced through the introduction of qualified majority voting (QMV) in areas relevant to the accession process by abolishing, in particular, the requirement for unanimity in the intermediate steps in the enlargement process when deciding on the opening and closing of individual negotiating clusters and chapters; regrets the fact that the overuse of unanimity in the intermediate steps in the enlargement process has repeatedly slowed down EU enlargement and is undermining popular support for EU integration;
